classification.difficultyReason: Recognise the swept region as the difference of concentric sectors, convert the common angle to radians, and apply the sector-area formula to both radii.

content.prompt:
A car windscreen wiper traces out an area $ABCD$ where $AB$ and $CD$ are arcs of circles with centre $O$ and radii $30\text{ cm}$ and $15\text{ cm}$ respectively. $\angle AOB=120^{\circ}$.

Find the area of $ABCD$ in exact form.

spec.description: An annular sector above O with outer endpoints A and B and inner endpoints D and C. The rays ODA and OCB remain visible. Light blue replaces source grey solely to identify the requested swept region.
spec.mathematics: Concentric sectors have radii 30 cm and 15 cm and a common central angle of 120 degrees. Their area difference is the area of ABCD.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source region and point labels are visible; no calculated area or additional measurements are shown.
